name: Hypothetical crew lander — Octavia E. Butler Landing
Skinner Ridge outcrop — Hawksbill Gap
rationale: Coarser-grained delta-front sandstone exposed where Perseverance climbed the fan front. Documents depositional energy and sediment source for the delta.
task: Document bedding and grain size; photograph the abraded/cored area at hand-lens scale.
source: M20_waypoints.json RMC 26_1004 (sol 477, last fix before sampling sol 490)

name: Wildcat Ridge outcrop — Hawksbill Gap
rationale: Fine-grained mudstone ~20 m from Skinner Ridge. Fine-grained lake/delta sediments are favoured environments for preserving organic matter and potential biosignatures.
task: Compare fine vs coarse textures with S1; context imaging of laminations and veins.
source: M20_waypoints.json RMC 26_1222 (sol 502, last fix before sampling sol 509)

name: Hidden Harbor outcrop — Cape Nukshak
rationale: Additional fan-front sedimentary stratigraphy on the Cape Nukshak campaign.
task: Stratigraphic context photography; measure bed orientations by eye/compass.
source: M20_waypoints.json RMC 30_1172 (sol 609, last fix before sampling sol 623)

name: Amalik outcrop — Cape Nukshak
rationale: Lower fan-front outcrop near the depot; links the delta stratigraphy to the depot area.
task: Document outcrop contacts; compare with S3.
source: M20_waypoints.json RMC 29_0 (sol 565, last fix before sampling sol 575)

name: Three Forks sample depot (inspection only)
note: Ten tubes were placed between sols 653 and 690. Individual tube positions are not transcribed here; the inspection point is the centroid of the rover's depot-build waypoints (VERIFY against the published depot map before any operational use).
